title: feat(sdk): add accountQuests() method
author: housir2001
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Adds `Pollinations.accountQuests()` to the JS SDK, fetching the quest catalog with the authenticated account's status from `GET /account/quests`.
- Follows the existing `accountBalance()`/`validateKey()` pattern (uses the internal `getJson<T>()` helper, no query params needed).
- New types (`AccountQuest`, `AccountQuestReward`, `AccountQuestsResponse`) mirror the Zod schemas defined server-side in `enter.pollinations.ai/src/routes/account.ts` (`accountQuestSchema`, `accountQuestRewardSchema`, `accountQuestsResponseSchema`), and are exported from `index.ts`.
- No server-side changes.

## Test plan
- [x] `bunx tsc --noEmit` (packages/sdk) — clean
- [x] `bunx vitest run src/client.test.ts` — 22/22 passing (1 new test for `accountQuests()`)
- [x] `bunx biome check` on changed files — clean

Closes #13770

gist.headline: Quests, now in your toolkit
gist.blurb: The JS SDK can now fetch your quest catalog with your account’s progress already tucked inside. Less manual API plumbing; more pollen for useful things.
gist.summary: Added `Pollinations.accountQuests()` to the JavaScript SDK, exposing authenticated `GET /account/quests` results plus exported `AccountQuest`, `AccountQuestReward`, and `AccountQuestsResponse` types.
gist.impact: JavaScript developers can now build quest-aware apps with account-specific completion and reward status through the SDK instead of wiring the account quests endpoint and response types themselves.
